verdict.rationale: Relay offers its own high-yield savings accounts, and auto-transfer rules sweep idle cash out of operating accounts into them. The cash stays inside Relay rather than going to a separate institution, and a community user confirms earning extra interest on allocated funds. missing for 10: documented APY tiers and conditions behind the "up to 3.00%" claim, any yield on the operating checking balance itself (rather than via a sweep to savings), and detailed independent hands-on corroboration of the sweep behavior.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can earn yield on operating cash balances without moving funds to a separate institution

citations.quote: Relay moves idle cash out of operating accounts and into your savings. Earn up to 3.00% APY1 on every spare dollar.
Relay’s auto-transfer rules make it easy by moving your excess cash out of operating accounts and into savings for you.
Build a cash cushion with high-yield accounts and automated rules that help you stay ready for whatever’s next.
Gives you a little extra interest on money allocated for taxes too.
